column1: # Ikaruga (Treasure's game in Nicalis's Switch port on NVN, SDK 3.5.0), update v131072 = 1.0.2.
# Started from the NSP script's provisional profile; the memory layout is the one it guessed, which boots and plays. No code of the game is cut.
# RomFS: three .arc archives, the sound (BFSAR, BFSTM) and two fonts. The shaders are compiled into main: 365 unique GLSLC outputs.
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region (the same 4 GB layout as Hyrule Warriors: Definitive Edition, SDK 3.5.1)
# the NPDM declares no system resource, so no virtual address memory; nninitStartup sets a 3.14 GB heap, of which about 400 MB is resident on the Mac in the first chapter
# the game calls nvnDeviceSetDepthMode with near = 0; it decides the mode of the pipeline bases made before the game runs
